Named lookup errors list provider names; unnamed lookups with only named
providers suggest //fabrik:inject for provider parameters and struct fields.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- store/store.go --
package store

type DB struct{ Addr string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

type Cache struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=warm
func NewWarmCache() *Cache { return &Cache{} }

type Reporting struct{ DB *DB }

//fabrik:inject db name=backup
//fabrik:provider
func NewReporting(db *DB) *Reporting { return &Reporting{DB: db} }

type Sync struct{ C *Cache }

//fabrik:provider
func NewSync(c *Cache) *Sync { return &Sync{C: c} }

type Mailer struct{ DB *DB }

//fabrik:inject db name=nightly
//fabrik:provider
func NewMailer(db *DB) *Mailer { return &Mailer{DB: db} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"app/store"
)

type API struct {
	Reporting *store.Reporting
	Sync      *store.Sync
	Cache     *store.Cache
}

//fabrik:http GET /api
func (a *API) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
